record.paper_title: Problemas abiertos en series de Fourier de Jacobi-Sobolev
record.context_brief: Mean convergence for Laguerre, Hermite, and Freud Sobolev expansions
record.original_question: For Fourier series with respect to orthogonal polynomials defined by the discrete Sobolev-type inner product with a single mass point at x=0, study mean convergence when the base measure mu is the Laguerre measure or the Hermite measure. Then determine how far such results can be extended to Freud measures dmu(x)=|x|^(alpha/2) exp(-|x|^beta) dx with alpha > -1 and beta > 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mu$ be a positive Borel measure on $\mathbb{R}$ with finite moments of all orders and infinite support, and consider the discrete Sobolev-type inner product with a single mass point at the origin:
$$\langle f,g\rangle_S = \int_{\mathbb{R}} f(x)g(x)\,d\mu(x) + M\, f'(0)g'(0),$$
where $M>0$. Let $\{Q_n\}_{n\ge 0}$ denote the sequence of monic orthogonal polynomials with respect to $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle_S$, and for $f$ in a suitable function space define the Fourier–Sobolev partial sums
$$S_n(f;x) = \sum_{k=0}^{n} \frac{\langle f, Q_k\rangle_S}{\langle Q_k,Q_k\rangle_S}\, Q_k(x).$$

(a) Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on $p$ and on weight functions $u,v$ such that the mean convergence
$$\lim_{n\to\infty}\|(S_n(f) - f)\,u\|_{L^p(v\,d\mu)} = 0$$
holds for all $f$ in an appropriate weighted $L^p$ space, when $d\mu(x) = x^\alpha e^{-x}\,dx$ on $(0,\infty)$ (Laguerre measure, $\alpha>-1$) and when $d\mu(x) = e^{-x^2}\,dx$ on $\mathbb{R}$ (Hermite measure).

(b) Extend the analysis to the family of Freud-type measures
$$d\mu(x) = |x|^{\alpha/2} e^{-|x|^\beta}\,dx, \qquad \alpha>-1,\ \beta>0,$$
on $\mathbb{R}$: determine the range of parameters $(\alpha,\beta,p)$ and admissible weights for which the corresponding Fourier–Sobolev partial sums converge in the mean.
artifact.status_search_result: Mean convergence of Fourier expansions in Sobolev orthogonal polynomials remains an active research area. The absence of a Christoffel–Darboux formula for Sobolev orthogonal polynomials makes convergence and summability questions difficult, and the problem of mean convergence for discrete Sobolev inner products based on Laguerre, Hermite, and especially Freud measures has not been fully resolved in the literature retrieved.

status_evidence.title: Relative asymptotics and Fourier series of orthogonal polynomials with a discrete Sobolev inner product
status_evidence.snippet: Pointwise convergence of Fourier series studied for Jacobi-type Sobolev inner products with mass points; mean convergence for Laguerre/Hermite/Freud cases not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Convergence results for discrete Sobolev Fourier series have been obtained chiefly in the Jacobi case, with the unbounded-support cases left for further work.

status_evidence.title: Fourier coefficients for Laguerre–Sobolev type orthogonal polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Fourier coefficients in the Laguerre-Sobolev setting; full mean convergence theorem not established.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to study Fourier coefficients in Laguerre-Sobolev expansions, indicating the mean convergence problem is still being investigated.
